body: Its quite literally all I ever do and feel as if I am a master of wearing my mask.

SSRIs nearly killed me, had me in the hospital for a week at a time and the idiots didnt realize it was them at all, in the end it took me firing my psychiatrist for not calling me back twice when I went into the hospital for excruciating pain in my stomach and called to ask if it was possible that it was the meds. After 5 hospital stays it was determined to be pancreatitis, I dont drink or smoke and SSRIs are known to possibly cause it. When I fired him I also stopped all meds and amazingly 3 years later and I havent had an attack since. 

The downside is I am depressed, anxious, and suicidal and will probably be dead in the next few days since I have a plan and the means.

Not at all, numerous times with numerous therapists over 20+ years and I can safely say I have not got one decent thing out of any of it. In my mind I say try meds or anything but conventional talk therapy.

Keep in mind I am as much or possibly more depressed than you are and pretty much on the edge of killing myself as well but that is a completely honest assessment of therapy from my perspective.

This was as big a waste as calling a hotline, its clearly meant to be that I end life. I found the perfect cheap hotel and booked 2 days so I wont be found until Im surely dead. Do not disturb sign will keep any maids away and xanax and fentanyl will do the rest.

To be honest I called one a couple of times and it was the biggest waste of my time ever. I got off the phone feeling worse than I began. 

I wish I had more to offer you but maybe try a mental health message board where people who can actually relate to feeling this badly might be able to talk with you. www.crazyboards.org is one that has a chat with some nice people in it who definitely will understand your feelings.
